title: Which Indian cricketer will publicly say by September 20, 2026, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his last for India?
background: The men's ODI World Cup is the global championship for cricket's 50-over international format.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : A public statement or interview by the player, quoted by a reputable news organization. 
  Resolution Condition : Identify the Indian cricketer who publicly declares between September 1 and September 20, 2026, inclusive, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his final World Cup representing India. The question resolves when the declaration is made, not when the player subsequently retires. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
